✔ missing final-session minute is a review date even with six complete signal bars (1.8687ms)

✔ unavailable position calculation does not invent zero points (2.8315ms)
✔ signals join decisions by direction AND review time (3.6011ms)
✔ signals after a gap stay not modelled, never assumed to be trades (3.3807ms)
✔ ledger hides stale open points but retains historical stop and target levels (5.1689ms)
✔ table pages, reverses, filters and searches without dropping rows (2.6808ms)
✔ five-year tables remain bounded to 20 rows per view (2.1503ms)
✔ data quality defaults to gaps and includes missing-minute detail (2.3361ms)
✔ tabs have one selected panel, lazy creation and keyboard navigation (4.7078ms)
✔ hedge plan never presents planned rules as historical positions (1.623ms)
✔ chart is ordered by exit and names spot points rather than cash equity (1.7989ms)
✔ new report defaults to option model with separate cash and spot summaries (5.8717ms)
✔ hedge records show entry charges only and independent calculation details (2.2826ms)
✔ unavailable and partial models never claim a full period cash result (5.0331ms)
✔ whole-empty-day holiday is explicit, not a zero-signal or verified day (3.0114ms)
✔ assumed whole days warn in both reports even with zero missing minute count (7.2549ms)

✔ skipped minutes continue totals but show approximate-result warnings (3.508ms)
✔ missing-price entry decisions and delayed option actions are explicit (4.8273ms)
